ai.summary: The FundraiseUp installation code was not found on https://www.hrw.org/. The page loaded with HTTP 200 in a headless browser. No FundraiseUp code, widget request, or global object was recorded. Google Tag Manager (GTM-W5D7ZP), two GA4 IDs, and a Meta Pixel were found. The browser did not click anything, so the checkout or donate button was not tested. The donate page at donate.hrw.org returned HTTP 403 to a plain HTTP client, so its content could not be read without JavaScript. Verdict: not installed.

customer_email.subject: FundraiseUp setup for hrw.org: next steps
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us on your donation platform setup. We checked https://www.hrw.org/ and could not find the FundraiseUp installation code in the page source. No widget request was recorded.

Please do the following:

1. Add the FundraiseUp installation code to the page source of https://www.hrw.org/.
2. Check that the donate page at https://donate.hrw.org/page/107245/donate/1 is reachable by standard web requests. It returned an access error (HTTP 403) during our check.
3. Let us know which cookie consent tool you use, if any, for visitors in the EU and UK.

Once these changes are live, reply to this email and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
